main_text.p: dam monumenta, cum veluti vibices flagellorum Dei semper in iis apparcant.

Et cessabit præsidium.) Coniungit regno Syriæ regnū Israel, & communia ait fore pericula. Per ironiam ait, parem fore gloriam Syriæ & filiorum Israel. Nam de quali gloria sentiat, ipse protinus interpretatur, adhibita etiam scita allegoria de carne, quæ prius pinguis fuerat, subito macrescente.

Et erit sicut qui colligit.) Amplificatio malorum. Asserit namque, admodum paucos in Syria & Israel fore tunc reliquos, qui non abducentur captiui. Utitur similitudinibus, quæ paucitatem illam appositissimè delineant. Sicut, inquit, qui messem demetit, ac deinde etiam tollit manipulos in pingui & fertili valle Rephaim (ea non procul est Jerosolymis ad septentrionalem plagam, Josuæ 18.) relinquit tantum paucas hinc inde spicas iacentes: & sicut qui oleæ baccas decerpit ac decutit, relinquit tantum quatuor aut quinque baccas in summitate arboris atque in extremitatibus ramorum: ita in Syria, præcipuè vero in regno Israel, ubi Assyriorum Rex longè lateq; omnia depopulabitur, tantum pauculi quidam miseri & abiecti relinquentur.
In die illa respiciet homo.) Comminatio-ni attexit aliquid conducens ad consolationem, nem-pe è paucis illis tum Israelitarum tum Syrorum reliquis, nonnullos olim perduci debere ad Euangelii

page.notes: Printed "Per iro" / "niam" appears split at the line end without a visible hyphen; written as one word. "apparcant" is as printed (possible error for "apparebunt"; not corrected). "Comminatio-" and "nem-" hyphens are printed as dash-like marks at the line ends. Long s and the s-like forms were read as s, and "sicut"/"ficut" was read as sicut. The line "reli-quijs" was split at the line end and written as "reliquis". "Euangelij" with final j is printed as an i-ending and is written as Euangelii.
